changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate 'NQ' (already covered by 'Natural Questions (NQ)') and normalized the name

Removed all metrics as they are used to evaluate retrieval performance (passage ranking/relevance), not NLG outputs (synthetic questions). The paper does not evaluate the quality of generated questions with automatic NLG metrics.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators of the generated synthetic questions.
No human evaluation of the synthetic questions is conducted. The paper only evaluates retrieval performance using standard IR metrics.

overall_notes: The paper's primary focus is on neural passage retrieval. It uses a T5-large model for generating synthetic questions as part of a pre-training strategy for the retrieval system, but does not systematically evaluate the quality of these generated questions (no automatic NLG metrics, no LLM-as-judge, no human evaluation). The extracted metadata for Question 1 is correct, but the metrics listed for Question 2 were incorrectly interpreted as evaluating NLG outputs rather than retrieval performance.
